intent: set the business place to Bahrain as the address form does (POST v1/managers/store/business-place, the first city Zid lists)
js: (async () => { const h = {"accept": "application/json", "accept-language": "en", "role": localStorage.getItem("role"), "store-id": localStorage.getItem("storeId"), "x-manager-token": localStorage.getItem("_t")}; const cr = await fetch("https://hermod.zid.sa/v1/settings/cities?per_page=3000&countries_ids=17", {headers: h, credentials: "include"}); const cj = await cr.json(); const cities = cj.cities || cj.results || cj.data || []; const city = cities[0]; const fd = new FormData(); fd.append("country_id", "17"); fd.append("city_id", String(city.id)); fd.append("district", "Capture District"); fd.append("street", "1 Capture Street"); fd.append("show_location", "0"); fd.append("_method", "put"); const r = await fetch("https://hermod.zid.sa/v1/managers/store/business-place", {method: "POST", headers: h, credentials: "include", body: fd}); return {cities_status: cr.status, cities_keys: Object.keys(cj), city: city && {id: city.id, en_name: city.en_name || city.name}, status: r.status, body: (await r.text()).slice(0, 600)}; })()

intent: set the business place back to Saudi Arabia, Riyadh, as the address form does (POST v1/managers/store/business-place)
js: (async () => { const h = {"accept": "application/json", "accept-language": "en", "role": localStorage.getItem("role"), "store-id": localStorage.getItem("storeId"), "x-manager-token": localStorage.getItem("_t")}; const cr = await fetch("https://hermod.zid.sa/v1/settings/cities?per_page=3000&countries_ids=184", {headers: h, credentials: "include"}); const cj = await cr.json(); const cities = cj.cities || cj.results || cj.data || []; const city = cities.find(c => c.id === 1) || cities[0]; const fd = new FormData(); fd.append("country_id", "184"); fd.append("city_id", String(city.id)); fd.append("district", "Capture District"); fd.append("street", "1 Capture Street"); fd.append("show_location", "0"); fd.append("_method", "put"); const r = await fetch("https://hermod.zid.sa/v1/managers/store/business-place", {method: "POST", headers: h, credentials: "include", body: fd}); return {cities_status: cr.status, cities_keys: Object.keys(cj), city: city && {id: city.id, en_name: city.en_name || city.name}, status: r.status, body: (await r.text()).slice(0, 200)}; })()
